# Copper Golem: Speed Upgrades

A simple mod that lets you upgrade Copper Golems' speed in three stages using upgrade items.
Use(right-click on the Copper Golem) 1 upgrade item to make a Copper Golem 2x faster, 2 items for 3x speed, and 3 items for 4x speed.
